interpretation: All 651 available English development tasks were executed. A strict categorical argument projection recognized 38 necessary-conclusion questions but rejected every case before reasoning because the complete passage was outside the supported monadic fragment. The runtime therefore returned no candidate on every task. Accuracy is absent rather than 0% because there were no evidential attempts.
